tools.name: shiyu_worker_probe_task
tools.description: 受限任务工具占位：仅用于证明 worker 工具预算与事件工具共同装配，探针中不可执行。

tools.name: shiyu_worker_event_types
tools.description: Discover the event report types this Assignment may publish. Returns type, schema version, payload fields, required fields, filterable fields and the trusted assignment scope. This grants nothing and cannot subscribe, wake a model or change task state.

tools.name: shiyu_worker_event_report
tools.description: Publish one scoped observation or reported result for this Assignment. Actor, scope, source trust level and allowed types are injected by the trusted runtime; they cannot be supplied in arguments. Reserved success facts (task.succeeded), verification receipts, owner grants and accounting facts are rejected. Retry with the same idempotencyKey and identical content.

payload.description: Exactly the registered payload fields. Maximum input 16 KiB; each string at most 8192 characters.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identity for this logical report, 1–256 characters; keep unchanged across retries.

tools.name: shiyu_core_event_types
tools.description: Read-only: list currently visible event types with schema version, payload fields, filterable fields, scope and whether this round may publish or subscribe. This grants no authority. At most one event-tool call is allowed this round; you must still return one final JSON candidate.

tools.name: shiyu_core_event_subscriptions
tools.description: Read-only: list this core Agent identity’s existing event subscriptions, their owner-scope revisions/activation generations and recent delivery references. Creating or changing subscriptions is not available in this round.

limit.description: Optional recent delivery reference count, 1–20; default 10.

tools.name: shiyu_core_event_report
tools.description: Publish one scoped observation for this goal as untrusted reported data. Actor, scope, source trust level and allowed type are injected by the trusted runtime and cannot be supplied in arguments. Reserved success facts, verification receipts, owner authorization and accounting facts are rejected. Acceptance is not task completion. At most one event-tool call is allowed this round; you must still return one final JSON candidate.

payload.description: Exactly the registered payload fields; bounded JSON.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identity for this logical observation, 1–256 characters; keep unchanged across retries.
